How TTMS powers Telematics

Collect, normalize, and operationalize telematics data from all fleet sources. Give dispatch and safety teams one accurate foundation for decisions. This service emphasizes multi-source telematics ingestion for mixed hardware environments.

  • Multi-source telematics ingestion for mixed hardware environments
  • Data normalization for consistent route, status, and event reporting
  • Live stream processing for operations and safety alerts
  • Historical trip reconstruction for investigations and analysis
  • Rule engine for custom event creation and escalations
  • Integration-ready data services for enterprise reporting tools

User Safety & Care

Unified telemetry enables quicker, safer operational intervention. Driver risk signals are detected earlier across the full network.

  • Unified telemetry enables quicker, safer operational intervention
  • Driver risk signals are detected earlier across the full network
  • Dispatch teams operate with confidence from trusted live inputs
  • Customers benefit from consistent ETA and service transparency

Telematics Audit & Compliance Reporting

Telematics data feeds TTMS reporting automatically so teams can plan telematics governance and data-quality standards first and maintain audit-ready records.

  • Telematics events are captured with timestamps and operational context for cleaner audit trails.
  • ELD, AI DashCam, and GPS records support compliance reporting without fragmented manual collection.
  • Owners can review KPI, exception, and safety logs in one TTMS - Total Transport Management System workflow.
  • Teams generate regulator-ready and customer-facing reports with accurate, centralized data.
